title: Sanitized Calapres business-event dedup row preview

event_key.$comment: Existing table-column alias whose only permitted value is event_identity_fingerprint. It must never contain replay_key_fingerprint, unsigned Delivery, or a raw identifier.

delivery_id.$comment: Null until a delivery identifier is proven to be inside the signed Chatwoot payload. The unsigned X-Chatwoot-Delivery header is never persisted here.

message_id.$comment: Reserved live-table column. Sanitized preview does not persist the raw identifier.

conversation_id.$comment: Reserved live-table column. Sanitized preview does not persist the raw identifier.

channel.$comment: Reserved live-table column. Channel is derived from the allowlisted inbox, never trusted from payload brand claims.

correlation_id.$comment: Reserved live-table column. Sanitized preview does not persist the raw correlation identifier.
